about: QT Town first-ten-minutes gate (NEXT-SLICES-3). OFFLINE only (blockDb + SDK stub + Play offline). Fresh profiles (localStorage cleared). Simulated time: the Phaser loop sleeps and the test steps game.headlessStep with a fixed 1/60 s. targets = the QT acceptance numbers. knownIssues = the measured value on the base branch for a target the game misses today (assert: not worse than this baseline; print the gap). legacySmall / legacyTiny / legacyUnderCanvas = frozen allow-lists of controls under 44 px / text under 12 px / controls whose centre shows the canvas, seen on the base branch: they may only shrink, a new offender fails.

legacySmall._notes: TN2 fixed every entry measured on 67cc086 (6 phone + 8 desktop controls at 40 px: the panel toggle, the quick-chat row, the trophy / Map / World map / Museum buttons are now >= 44 px). The lists are empty: any control under 44 px fails the gate.

legacyTiny._notes: TN2 raised the In-town panel lines (streak, town rating, tidy, birthday, bestie, Map / World map) and the phone action-button labels (Emotes, Tilt, the A/B/P/C captions) from 10-11 px to 12 px. The lists are empty: any visible text under 12 px fails the gate.

legacyUnderCanvas._notes: TN2: on desktop the In-town panel may use the full right edge (max-height 100vh - 32px) and the quick-chat row wraps, so Today, Journal, Settings and the last quick-chat button are reachable without scrolling at 1280x720. Empty: any clipped control fails the gate.
